briefing.headline: GOOGL jumps 3.98% as tech tokens rally overnight
briefing.summary: All ten core tech tokens posted gains, driving the Nasdaq‑linked QQQ up 1.81% and the broad market SPY up 1.03%. The average move among the core group was 1.88%, but several mega‑caps outperformed that level. In contrast, three non‑core tickers (AGL, SA, SLS) suffered steep declines, while a handful of small‑cap or leveraged names posted double‑digit spikes. Overall breadth was strongly positive with 10 advancers and no core decliners.
